name: com.amberstocks/amber-finance
title: Amber Finance
description: SEC filings, stock-based compensation, cash flow, and valuation data for US companies.

tools.name: amber_get_company
tools.description: Get SEC EDGAR-verified fundamentals for a public US company: True Free Cash Flow (FCF minus Stock-Based Compensation), SBC % of revenue, 4-year share dilution, Reverse DCF implied 10-year revenue growth, balance sheet, recent 10-K/10-Q filing diffs, and Form 4 insider buys. Includes canonical Amber links.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, PLTR).

tools.name: amber_screen_companies
tools.description: Screen 720+ Nasdaq and NYSE companies by True Free Cash Flow margin, Stock-Based Compensation burden, 4-year net share dilution, Reverse DCF implied growth, sector, or curated Amber discovery lenses (cash-machines, buyback-cannibals, underpriced, rule-of-40, hidden-dilution, insider-buys, material-events).

sector.description: Optional sector name or slug (e.g. technology, healthcare).

maxDilution.description: Maximum 4Y annual share count change % (negative = buybacks).

minMarketCapB.description: Minimum market cap in billions USD.

tools.name: amber_compare_companies
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 public companies side-by-side on Market Cap, True FCF Margin, Stock-Based Compensation %, 4Y share dilution, and Reverse DCF priced-in growth, returning a shareable Amber comparison URL.

tools.name: amber_get_recent_signals
tools.description: Fetch recent high-signal SEC 10-K/10-Q filing prose diffs, Form 8-K events, and open-market Form 4 insider purchases across the market or for a specific ticker.
